summary: cad/parameters.py: measured values load from analysis/*.json (outline, thickness, holes, component bboxes+heights). Design literals with provenance: WALL/FLOOR 1.6, CORNER_R 3.0, BOSS_OUTER 6.0 (drill 2.7 + wall), BOSS_PILOT 2.1 (M2.5 self-tap, coupon-verify), BOARD_SEAT_Z 3.0, USB envelope class dims, HDR_EXIT_REACH 10, LID_LIP 1.2 / LID_GAP 0.25.
